visualCharacteristics.purpose: Open job positions as full-width cards
visualCharacteristics.description: One full-width light-grey card per job with a cut-off top-right corner on mobile. Title at the top (VIEW DETAILS link with north-east arrow at the top right from 768px), a divider, then location (pin icon added by the block), employment type and experience in a row (stacked with dividers on mobile). From 768px a hovered or focused card turns navy, gets a 40px cut corner and white text. More than 4 jobs are paginated client-side, 4 per page, with numbered page buttons and Previous/Next.
visualCharacteristics.source: Careers page #job-listing (.job-listings .job-card) and the About us / Contact us recent-jobs widget (.recent-jobs-widget).

contentPattern.structure: One row per job, one cell: H3 job title, location paragraph, employment type paragraph, experience paragraph, View details link

reuseGuidance: Use for lists of job openings (or similar text-only listings) where each item links to its own detail page. The first paragraph after the title gets the location pin; the last link-only paragraph is the card link. Author every job in one table: the block shows 4 per page and adds the pager itself.
